mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id AS historyId, m.merchant_name AS title, l.ledger_type AS ledgerType, h.amount AS amount, h.balance_before AS balanceBefore, h.balance_after AS balanceAfter, h.created_at AS createAt FROM wallet_histories h INNER JOIN wallet_ledgers l ON h.ledger_id = l.ledger_id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON h.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE h.wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
